title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19080v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object detectors often produce over-confident predictions for objects outside their training categories, leading to so-called out-of-distribution (OoD) hallucinations. Existing approaches for detecting or mitigating such hallucinations typically either construct scoring functions directly over learned object detector representations or modify the object detector itself to suppress hallucination emergence. However, the latent priors implicitly encoded in these representations remain largely unexplored and have not been explicitly decoded for OoD detection. To uncover and exploit these latent priors, we propose Structured Prior Knowledge (SPK), a hallucination-oriented framework that explicitly elicits OoD-relevant priors from pretrained object detectors. translated_title: SPK：为实时目标检测中的可解释分布外检测引出结构化先验知识
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19080v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：目标检测器通常会对其训练类别之外的对象产生过度自信的预测，导致所谓的分布外（OoD）幻觉。现有检测或缓解此类幻觉的方法通常直接在学习的检测器表示上构建评分函数，或修改检测器本身以抑制幻觉的产生。然而，这些表示中隐含编码的潜在先验在很大程度上未被探索，也未被明确解码用于OoD检测。为了揭示并利用这些潜在先验，我们提出了结构化先验知识（SPK），这是一种面向幻觉的框架，旨在从预训练的目标检测器中明确引出与OoD相关的先验。具体而言，SPK利用分布内数据和诱发幻觉的样本作为诊断监督，以引出目标检测器决策背后的部分级语义概念。
tldr: SPK通过利用分布内数据和幻觉诱导样本作为诊断监督，从预训练目标检测器中明确引出结构化先验知识，从而实现对分布外幻觉的可解释检测。
en_tdlr: SPK explicitly elicits structured prior knowledge from pretrained object detectors using in-distribution and hallucination-inducing samples as diagnostic supervision, enabling interpretable out-of-distribution hallucination detection.
